Jharkhand HC enhances acid attack compensation, seeks scheme review

The Jharkhand High Court has increased the compensation for a male acid attack survivor from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 15 lakh, calling the initial amount 'meagre'. The court observed a disparity in compensation between male and female victims and suggested the state amend its scheme to ensure equal treatment. This action highlights concerns about gender-based disparities in victim compensation.
